# jochwacht-sbom 0.18.0 — Go lists the LINKED set, not all of go.sum

- **Go dependencies are now the set that is actually linked.** When a Go
  toolchain and a `go.mod` are present, jochwacht-sbom resolves the build with
  `go list -deps` from the module's own `package main` (a pure library falls
  back to all packages), with `replace` directives resolved to the module that
  is really built. `go.sum` is no longer read directly in that case — it lists
  *every* version a project ever saw, including superseded ones, which is not
  the built set.
- **Without a Go toolchain it still works**, falling back to `go.sum` and
  saying so: those versions are marked as unresolved, and the free report notes
  that a `go.sum`-only bill may list versions that are not in the built product.
